description: Universidad Veracruzana publishes responses and questionnaire materials on perceived urban resilience in the Veracruz–Boca del Río metropolitan area. The article reports 147 respondents across four municipalities and describes ten questionnaire axes, thirty-three indicators and 156 variables. Zenodo version DOI 10.5281/zenodo.17436266 contains spreadsheets and documents under CC BY 4.0, available without charge; DOI 10.5281/zenodo.13786160 names the same deposit’s concept and versions. The responses can inform community-behaviour assumptions in urban resilience or emergency-service simulations. This small voluntary sample measures perception, not observed infrastructure performance, and the uneven municipal counts limit local estimates. The workbooks were not inspected. No directly related catalogue dataset was identified. Geographic coverage is four municipalities in the Veracruz–Boca del Río metropolitan area; it is limited to the article’s voluntary survey respondents.
